name: Stalwart
author: voodoo573
description: Feat from Level Up: Advanced 5th Edition. You can quickly recover from injuries that leave lesser creatures broken. - Raise your Constitution attribute by 1, up to the attribute cap of 20. - You regain an additional number of hit points equal to double your Constitution modifier (minimum 2) whenever you roll a hit die to regain hit points.
summary: +1 Constitution and extra healing whenever you roll a Hit Die.
